info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Test Subscriptions Management API
info.description: The Test Subscriptions Management API enables users to validate webhook event configurations by retrieving test subscription information. This endpoint is crucial for developers and system integrators who want to ensure that their webhook implementations are functioning correctly. By accessing test subscriptions for specific webhooks and events, users can confirm that notifications are sent as intended. Typical consumers include developers testing integrations and quality assurance teams performing system checks.

get.summary: Fetches test subscriptions for a specified webhook.
get.description: This endpoint retrieves the test subscriptions associated with a particular webhook identified by its resource ID. It is useful for validating the webhook configuration and ensuring that events are being triggered correctly.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve test subscription events for the specified webhook. It allows users to validate their webhook implementation by making a request to test the event subscriptions associated with the given webhook.

GetTestSubscriptionsForWebhookRes100045R.description: This schema represents the payload structure for the GET request to test subscriptions for a webhook event.

GetTestSubscriptionsForWebhookRes100045R.title: Webhook Test Subscriptions Response
